about: Which standing topic (if any) a job-application question asks about. 'form' cases are real questions from saved application forms; 'made-up' cases are rewordings and traps. A wrong topic is the dangerous error: it puts a saved answer on a question it does not answer. 'none' means the agent should not use any standing answer.
